hints.text: $10^3$ is $1{,}000$, so the number gets a thousand times bigger.
Slide the decimal point three places to the right: $0.047 \to 0.47 \to 4.7 \to ?$

explanation: $10^3 = 1{,}000$, and multiplying by it moves the decimal point three places right.
Shift one: $0.047 \to 0.47$. Shift two: $0.47 \to 4.7$. Shift three: $4.7 \to 47$.
